wait_download() {
    local logfile=$1
    local marker=$2
    local name=$3
    log "Waiting for $name download..."
    while ! grep -q "$marker" "$logfile" 2>/dev/null; do
        sleep 15
    done
    log "$name download COMPLETE"
}

# Run annotation
run_annotation() {
    local script=$1
    local model_path=$2
    local gpu=$3
    local name=$4
    local expected_csv=$5
    
    log "Starting $name annotation on cuda:$gpu with model $model_path"
    python "$SCRIPTS/$script" \

        --device "cuda:$gpu" \
        --z-definition balanced \
        2>&1
    
    if [ -f "$expected_csv" ]; then
